found.text: Let us know with one tap — it tells us whether HOMI helps you search.
found.congratsText: Thanks for telling us. If HOMI helped, tell your friends — they’ll find it useful too.
found.shareText: Found my new place through HOMI 🎉 The bot gathers listings from Telegram channels into one feed, removes duplicates, marks owners vs. realtors and sends new ones that match your filters. If you’re looking for a place, give it a try — it’s free.
